sources.title: Country-labelled Moroccan surname list, secondary compilation
sources.romanization_convention: Original published Latin spellings, no automatic Arabic romanization
sources.limitations: Country association from secondary surname category; residency and licence not independently audited
sources.expansion_selection: Preserve the original 500 source-observed values; append additional single source-record surnames in this pinned Morocco-category file. No invented surname combinations or generated Arabic romanizations.

sources.title: Country MA surname-directory entries, locatefamily.com crawl (July 2019), Surname Dispersion Dataset
sources.license: MIT repository; upstream directory-data rights unverified
sources.romanization_convention: Source-published Latin surname field retained unchanged; native diacritics only where published. No Arabic or Berber spellings algorithmically converted.
sources.selection: After preserving the original 500 and unique legacy-Morocco records, append country-MA last-name values in published order, excluding invalid or very short fragments, standalone particles, obvious company labels and equivalent spellings. Published percentages are discarded; all 3000 values are sampled uniformly.
sources.limitations: Third-party 2019 public directory crawl, not a Moroccan official registry. Potential given-name/business contamination, resident status, completeness, and data redistribution rights are not independently attested. Research-only.
